message.text:
I need to find the two protocols serving MemoService and identify the files where each protocol is registered or wrapped.

ConnectRPC and gRPC-gateway (REST) are the two protocols. Now I am locating the files where each is registered.

Found the two protocols in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go`. REST/gRPC gateway uses `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Connect uses `NewConnectServiceHandler` and `RegisterConnectHandlers`.

Checking whether a third native gRPC server exists in `v1.go`. `connect_services.go` wraps the Connect handler.

One protocol is gRPC-Gateway (REST/HTTP). Its registration is in server/router/api/v1/v1.go via RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer. The second protocol is still being identified.

The second protocol is ConnectRPC. Its wrapping is in server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go. Its registration is in server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go.

The answer should list exactly two lines, one file per protocol. The gRPC-Gateway registration is in server/router/api/v1/v1.go. The ConnectRPC registration is in server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go.

q19.
gRPC-Gateway — server/router/api/v1/v1.go
Connect — server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go

`RegisterGateway` in `server/router/api/v1/v1.go` registers MemoService on the gRPC-Gateway mux via `RegisterMemoServiceHandlerServer`. Connect registration is `RegisterConnectHandlers` in `server/router/api/v1/connect_handler.go` (`apiv1connect.NewMemoServiceHandler`); `ConnectServiceHandler` wrappers live in `server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go`. There is no separate native gRPC listener.
